articles.summary: Compugen Ltd. (NASDAQ: CGEN) (TASE: CGEN) a clinical-stage cancer immunotherapy company and a pioneer in computational target discovery powered by AI, today announced that management will participate in the following upcoming investor conferences in November 2026: Stifel 2026 Healthcare Conference Date: Tuesday, November 10, 2026 Location: New York, NY Format: Fireside chat and 1x1 meetings Fireside chat time: 11:20 am ET 2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference Date: Wednesday and Thursday, November 18-19, 2026 Location: London, UK Format: 1x1 meetings Please contact your Stifel or Jefferies representative for additional information or to schedule a meeting with Compugen. A live webcast of the fireside chat will be available on the events page of the Investor Relations section of Compugen's website at www.cgen.com . A replay will be available following the live event.
